subject.title: fix(subagent): recover terminal transcript before lost context

question: Should OpenClaw accept this PR's current-run private transcript `stop`/`end_turn` predicate as the recovery boundary for the Agent Teams lost-context bug?
rationale: The change fixes a real lifecycle mismatch but intentionally converts some stale subagent runs from failed to successful, which affects session state and parent message delivery.

options.title: Accept After Refresh
options.body: Refresh the draft against current main, run exact-head validation, and accept the private transcript predicate as the bounded fix.

options.title: Require Live Gateway Proof
options.body: Ask for a live Agent Teams/Gateway run that demonstrates context loss recovery before accepting the lifecycle behavior change.

options.title: Keep Error-Only Fallback
options.body: Reject this recovery direction and keep the lost-context error unless a stronger terminal-state signal is added elsewhere.

recommendation.title: Accept After Refresh
recommendation.body: Refresh the draft against current main, run exact-head validation, and accept the private transcript predicate as the bounded fix.

likelyOwner.reason: They made the clearest maintainer statement on the required private transcript/status boundary in the related closed PR.
